snippet.title: Tezzel: The Tilemaker’s Tale | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Tezzel: The Tilemaker’s Tale is a cozy, colorful, and deeply challenging puzzle game where every move shapes a masterpiece.

🎮 Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3703730/?utm_source=YoutubeT1

Features
🧩 100+ handcrafted puzzles
🎨 10 unique tilemaking tools
🕊️ Relaxed pacing, nonlinear progression
🏛️ A tribute to tile artistry and old-world Barcelona

Stay tunned:
X/Twitter: https://x.com/oldmayorstudios
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/oldmayorstudios.bsky.social
